sections.title: 1. Introduction & Module Overview
sections.intro:
Finance module hotel ka double-entry accounting system hai — saare revenue (FO, POS, Banquet, Laundry) aur expenses yahin consolidate hote hain.

Analysis HMS me Finance flow: Masters me accounts banao (Group → Ledger) → Transactions (Voucher Entry) → Verification → Reports (Trial Balance, P&L, Balance Sheet). POS/Front Office ke settlement heads (Cash/UPI/Card/City Ledger) automatically finance me post hote hain — accountant ki manual entry sirf adjustments/journal ke liye rehti hai.

subsections.title: 2.1 Group Accounts
subsections.paragraph: Chart of accounts ke groups — Assets, Liabilities, Income, Expenses ke sub-groups. Ledger accounts inhi groups me bante hain, isliye pehle group structure sahi banao.

rows: P&L me gross me aayega ya nahi

subsections.title: 2.2 Ledger Accounts
subsections.paragraph: Actual accounts jahan transactions post hoti hain — Cash, Bank, MakeMyTrip, GST Payable, Salary, Rent etc. Har ledger kisi group ke under banta hai.

subsections.title: 2.3 FA Parameter & TDS Category
subsections.navPath: Finance ▶ Master ▶ FA Parameter / T.D.S. Category
subsections.paragraph: FA Parameter: finance module ke global settings (financial year start, voucher numbering, posting rules). TDS Category: TDS ke types (194C contractor 1%/2%, 194J professional 10%) — vendor payments me auto-TDS calc ke liye.

rows: FY start, voucher prefix/series, rounding, auto-post rules
Section, rate %, threshold, TDS ledger mapping

subsections.title: 3.1 Voucher Entry
subsections.paragraph: Manual accounting entries — Payment, Receipt, Journal, Contra, Sales/Purchase (non-HMS). Debit-Credit balance hona zaroori hai warna save nahi hota.

subsections.title: 3.2 Bank Reconciliation
subsections.paragraph: Bank statement ke transactions system entries se match karo — cleared entries pe tick lagao. Difference = uncleared cheques/charges. Monthly reconcile karna best practice hai.
steps: Bank ledger select karo + statement period
System entries vs bank statement compare karo
Matched entries pe cleared tick lagao
Bank charges/interest ki journal entry karo (missing ho to)
Save — balance difference zero hona chahiye

subsections.title: 3.3 Verification Dashboard
subsections.paragraph: Internal control — entered vouchers verify/approve karne ka dashboard. Verified hi vouchers final reports me effectively 'trusted' state me aate hain (parameter ke hisaab se).

rows: Verification ka wait kar rahe vouchers
Checker ne dekh ke approve kiya
Saare ledgers ka Dr/Cr closing balance — tally check
Har ledger ki transaction-wise detail (date, voucher, running balance)

subsections.title: 4.1b Trail Group & Detailed Ledger
subsections.navPath: Finance ▶ Report ▶ Trail Group / Detailed Trial Ledger
subsections.paragraph: Trail Group: group-wise TB summary. Detailed Trial Ledger: har ledger ki date-wise transactions with running balance — party statement jaisa.

subsections.title: 4.2 Compliance & Bank Reports
subsections.caption: Cheque Not Cleared Register — pending follow-up list
subsections.paragraph: TDS Report: category-wise TDS deducted — quarterly e-TDS filing ke liye. Cheque Registers: cleared aur not-cleared cheques — bank follow-up ke liye.
